bengaluru.name: GBA helpline (toll-free)
bengaluru.what: Potholes, waterlogging, fallen trees, streetlights, garbage

chennai.name: Namma Chennai app
chennai.what: Complaints with a photo and location; you can track them

mumbai.name: MyBMC 24x7 app
mumbai.what: Complaints with a photo; you can track them

roads.name: National highways helpline (NHAI)
roads.what: Only for national highways: potholes, accidents, toll plazas

national.name: CPGRAMS
national.what: Grievances against central government offices; it also forwards grievances to state governments. You get a number to track the reply.

national.name: RTI
national.what: When you need the records, not just a fix

mla_odisha.name: MLALADS cell, Planning & Convergence Department, Odisha
mla_odisha.what: Questions about MLALADS works anywhere in Odisha

mla_odisha.name: Block Development Officer
mla_odisha.how: The block office where the work is
mla_odisha.what: Most MLALADS works are carried out by the Panchayati Raj department through blocks

mp.name: District authority (MPLADS cell)
mp.how: The Collector or Deputy Commissioner's office named on the work
mp.what: Sanction, delays, payments and completion of MPLADS works

mp.name: MoSPI (runs MPLADS)
mp.what: When the district does not respond

mp.name: Suggest a work to your MP
mp.what: Ask your MP to fund a work in your area
